entries.source: "Delekhan united the clans of the north at this spot. All who visit here should kneel and praise the gods for his grand power and wisdom."�
entries.translation: 「迪勒肯正是在此地統一了北境諸部族。凡到訪此地者，皆應跪下讚頌諸神，感念他的偉大力量與智慧。」�

entries.source: Latham McCann "Loved the mines. Never wanted to leave."�
entries.translation: 雷瑟姆．麥肯 「熱愛礦坑，從未想過離開。」�

entries.source:
Thoughts filled his mind.
	Slowing in recollection, Gorath focused on his surroundings. The caverns themselves appeared unremarkable, yet this was a ruin of things ancient... What had been written in the Abbot's Journal? A chest... shell... Might it be?�
entries.translation:
思緒湧上心頭。
	戈拉斯放緩了回憶的腳步，將注意力集中在四周環境上。這些洞穴本身看似平凡無奇，卻是古老遺跡的殘骸…院長日誌裡寫的是什麼來著？一只木箱…貝殼…會是這個嗎？�
